source: Owner replies in a Claude Code session after the Gate 07 report (pull request edlung/DnD_Living-Tabletop-World#16)
question: Исправлять четыре Medium-находки Gate 07?

disposition.G07-05..G07-10 (Low) and I-01..I-21 (Inf: Not in this remediation; open for a later disposition

productDecisions.question: Сколько платных задач один владелец мастерской может держать в очереди одновременно (G07-01)?
productDecisions.meaning: Generation or edit: one active per draft and at most two per owner; pictures: at most four active per owner. A request over the bound gets a clear 'wait for completion' refusal, and the queue serves owners in turn.

productDecisions.question: Как разрешать владельцу платную генерацию картинок (G07-02)?
productDecisions.meaning: A new operator command enables or disables paid pictures per owner, separately from text. Owners whose latest text preparation grant is enabled keep pictures automatically at the upgrade (migration 0024).

unchanged: no deployment, credential, provider or default-database change
